author: ChertanProject
body: hi I want to play mineman again since school is over for me. I've played mc for 4 years and OCN for almost 3 years and t5 and t6. I've played for squadcatt in OCN and avicus, celestial, HWEC etc and I've played multiple tourneys. I play offense but I can play other positions as well other than defense which I suck at. I think I'm alright at pvp and I can bridge, solo push into the wool and out U know all those things an offender can do. I prefer an English team that can consistently make it at least to the invitationals. I prefer the teams ability rather than language. Thankyou for reading
